Sexual assault referral centres offer medical, practical and emotional support to anyone who has been sexually assaulted or raped. They have specially trained pediatrician / Forensic Nurse Examiners (FNE)  and support workers to care for you.

At Serenity Sexual Assault Referral Centre (SARC) it’s about YOU and how we can help YOU deal with what has happened. Serenity specialises in providing a one-stop-shop approach for men, women and children who have experienced sexual violence or abuse. You do not have to tell the police if you don’t wish to.  

We have the experience and knowledge to guide you through your next steps, assist your recovery and help you decide what you want to do.

We are located within an NHS building but entirely self contained and with separate discreet entrances. Within the centre you can access immediate services to protect your health and save evidence, and also access longer term services that provide ongoing help, information and support.

You can visit Serenity SARC for a medical examination following a recent rape or assault at any time. 

For anyone under 18 there is a dedicated  service - East Midlands Children and Young People's Sexual Assault Service delivered in partnership by Nottingham University Hospital
Trust with Northamptonshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust. www.emcypsas.co.uk

Metrics.ElementText: Please telephone for an appointment, telephone line open Monday - Friday, 9am-5pm.  Please note that we no longer offer walk in clinics.

We see patients who simply want a sexual health screen for their own peace of mind or those experiencing symptoms of a sexually transmitted infection. We also see patients with genital skin conditions.
Clinic

Services provided at this clinic include full screening and treatment of sexually transmitted infections, HIV screening and screening for other blood borne infections, HIV treatment, counselling and support, partner notification and contact screening and treatment, full range of contraceptive methods including emergency contraception, insertion of IUD/S (coils) and contraceptive implants, pregnancy testing, chlamydia screening, condoms.

We also offer specialist clinics for GUM procedures, biopsies, genital skin conditions, erectile dysfunction and sexual assault victims. This is also a training venue for pre-registered nursing and medical students and provides training for nurses and doctors to attain the (N)DFSRH.

We offer pre booked appointments only.

The Specialist Stop Smoking Service is part of Salford City Council's Health Improvement Service. We've been supporting people in Salford to quit smoking for over 16 years with a high success rate.

You’re three times more likely to quit with our specialist support! It can be done - 61% of people who have ever smoked in Great Britain have quit and are now ex-smokers.

You'll be supported for up to 12 weeks by one of our friendly Stop Smoking Advisors. We'll help you to identify your daily smoking habits, offer practical advice on managing cravings, and develop your personalised quit plan to help you quit smoking for good.

We provide free access to nicotine replacement therapy, such as patches, chewing gums, mouth sprays, and more. We also offer medications to help people quit smoking (like bupropion/Zyban), as well as vaping devices (e-cigarette).
